title: Use Page Regions to Present your Reports and Data in Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)

chapters.title: Call to action and sandbox availability

features.name: Page regions for spreadsheet presentation
features.description: Ability to define multiple regions within a spreadsheet that appear as separate tabbed areas in preview mode. Regions can have background colors and are ordered by their assigned IDs.
caveats: Region order is based on the ID assigned to each region

features.name: Preview mode with tabbed navigation
features.description: When previewing a spreadsheet, regions are displayed as tabs at the bottom, allowing users to switch between different regions. Scrolling is limited to within each region's area.
caveats: Scrolling is limited to the area within each region

features.name: Print functionality for regions
features.description: Each region in a spreadsheet becomes a separate page when printed, allowing users to print spreadsheets with multiple regions in a structured format.

features.name: Spreadsheet permissions and read-only access
features.description: Owner can control who has access to spreadsheets by granting read-only permissions to other users. Users with read-only access can view the spreadsheet in preview mode but cannot edit it.
caveats: A spreadsheet must always have an owner
Read-only users can only see spreadsheets they have been granted access to

features.name: Slicers in preview mode
features.description: Slicers in spreadsheets remain available and functional in preview mode, allowing users to interact with and filter data by selecting values like dates or counts.
caveats: Slicers cannot be edited in preview mode, only used for filtering

features.name: Real-time data in spreadsheets
features.description: Spreadsheets display live, real-time data directly from Business Central with no staging or syncing delays, providing instant access to current data.
